You are U11AFIX, a scoped fix implementer on the jrit-loop plugin port. You edit exactly ONE file: /home/jjrdar/repos/loop-stack-session/docs/drive-logs/B32/u11a-sweep-commands.md (the staged C8 tracker-sweep packet). You have no worktree duties; do not touch any git repo, and NEVER run any gh mutation (transfer, close, comment, label, edit). Read-only gh calls (issue list, issue view) are allowed for verification.

CONTEXT: an adversarial validation found one blocking defect and two gaps in the packet. The disposition content (16 transfers, 3 closes, 5 stay-open comments, 7 labels, verbatim texts) is verified correct - preserve all of it. Read the packet fully before editing. The plan's Task 11 is at /home/jjrdar/repos/loop-stack-session/docs/plans/2026-09-13.B32.jrit-loop-plugin-port-plan.md lines 1025-1056; D12 at 400-414.

THE THREE FIXES:
1. BLOCKING - the #3 migration-note target. The packet currently captures the comment target with: n3=$(gh issue list -R jroethel/jrit-loop --state all --limit 1 --json number -q '.[0].number') on the reasoning that #3 transfers last so its copy is the newest issue. That is wrong: gh issue list sorts by CREATION date, GitHub preserves created_at across transfers, and #3 is the OLDEST of the 24 - so $n3 would resolve to #64's copy and the note would land on the wrong issue. Fix: remove #3 from the transfer loop; transfer it as its own final command, capturing the new-issue URL that gh issue transfer prints on stdout into a variable (url3=$(gh issue transfer 3 jroethel/jrit-loop -R jroethel/loop-stack-session)), and target the migration-note comment at that URL directly (gh issue comment accepts a URL). The fix must not depend on any list-sort behavior.
2. URL capture for the migration map. Task 11 step 6 requires capturing each old-number-to-new-URL pair as it runs; the current loop discards all printed URLs. Amend the transfer loop so each transfer's stdout URL is captured and appended as a line "old=#<n> new=<url>" to /home/jjrdar/repos/loop-stack-session/docs/drive-logs/B32/u11b-transfer-urls.txt, and add one sentence telling the firer these pairs fill the pending cells in docs/issue-migration-map.md afterward. The solo #3 transfer appends its pair too, so the file ends with 16 lines.
3. Real stop at the dry-run gate. The whole command list is one fenced block, so a whole-block paste would blow through the "verify the dry-run before the loop" gate. Split it into separate fenced bash blocks: (a) label provisioning, (b) the #7 dry-run transfer plus its verification reads, then an UNFENCED prose line in bold instructing the firer to stop and verify #7 landed with labels intact before continuing, (c) the 14-transfer loop (#7 and #3 both out of it now) with URL capture, (d) the solo #3 transfer + its comment, (e) closes and stay-open comments, (f) the loop-stack-session mirror deletion commit. Adjust the loop's issue list and any counts/prose accordingly: the loop covers 14 issues, #7 via the dry-run, #3 solo, total still exactly 16 transfers.

PRESERVE: every verbatim comment text, the close reasons, the label set, the -R source qualifier on every transfer, the stated end state (5 open in loop-stack-session, 16 in jrit-loop), the disclosure that the five stay-open comment bodies are composed.

VERIFY YOURSELF, recording real outputs in your log file /home/jjrdar/repos/loop-stack-session/docs/drive-logs/B32/unit-11afix.md (first line: "AGENT STATUS unit=u11afix branch=n/a verdict=self-pass repairs=0"): the transfer-number union across dry-run + loop + solo = exactly {3,7,15,18,28,33,36,40,45,48,51,56,61,62,63,64}; #3 appears in no loop; zero mutations executed (gh issue list -R jroethel/loop-stack-session --state open still 24; jrit-loop still 0 issues); no em dash; every prose line one sentence.

WHEN THE PACKET IS FIXED AND YOUR LOG IS WRITTEN, STOP IMMEDIATELY AND RETURN.
